name: openwork
description: The open-source alternative to Claude Cowork (powered by opencode)
readmeExcerpt: # OpenWork OpenWork is a free, open-source desktop app made for sharing AI workflows. It is an open-source alternative to Claude Cowork and Codex for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Add one OpenWork MCP to Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or another compatible agent and reuse the same skills, MCPs, and connected services across your tools, teammates, and machines. Create something once, share it with coworkers or friends, or keep it for yourself. The desktop app is there when you want a dedicated workspace, but it is not required. You can use OpenWork from the agent you already have. For larger organizations, the admin interface lets you publish capabilities, manage access, and configure shared or per-user connections. [**Download OpenWork**](https://openworklabs.com/download) ## Install with your AI agent Already use an AI agent? Copy this prompt and paste it into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, ChatGPT, or any agent that can run commands on your computer. ```text Install OpenWork on my computer, set up my first workspace, and open it ready to use. Follow the steps in https://openworklabs.com/start.md?v=hero ``` 1. Installs OpenWork 2. Creates your workspace 3. Opens it ready to run ## Use OpenWork from any agent The OpenWork MCP brings your assigned skills, plugins, MCP connections, Google Workspace, and Microsoft 365 capabilities into any compatible agent. It exposes two tools: `search_capabilities` finds what you can use, and `execute_capability` runs it. After adding the MCP, your client opens a browser so you can sign in and choose your OpenWork organization. ### Codex ```bash codex mcp add openwork --url https://api.openworklabs.com/mcp/agent ``` ### Claude Code ```bash claude mcp add --transport http openwork https://api.openworklabs.com/mcp/agent ``` ### OpenCode Add this to `opencode.json`: ```json { "mcp": { "openwork": { "type": "remote", "enabled": true, "url": "https://api.openworklabs.com/mcp/agent", "oauth": {} } } } ``` ### Any MCP client Use this remote MCP server URL: ```text https://api.openworklabs.com/mcp/agent ``` ## OpenWork Den OpenWork Den is the control plane for managing OpenWork across a team or organization. - Provision inference at scale and control which members and teams can use each model provider. - Invite teammates, create teams, and manage access from one place. - Set desktop policies, restrict local model access, and control which app versions your organization can use. - Publish skills and plugins through marketplaces, then assign them to the organization, a team, or specific people. - Import Anthropic-compatible plugins and make their supported skills and remote MCPs available through the OpenWork MCP.

analysis.oneLine: openwork 是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，适合用于提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。
analysis.problem: AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束
analysis.audience: 使用 AI 编程的开发者、技术负责人、希望建立团队级 AI 编码规范的小团队
detailParagraphs: openwork 更准确地说是一个面向 AI 编程工作流的规则与提示词资产，而不是一个只因为短期热度上榜的仓库。对国内用户来说，判断重点不应停留在 README 的自我描述，而要看它是否能解决一个真实、可复用、可持续维护的工作流问题：AI 编程工具容易在上下文、测试、回滚和任务边界上犯重复错误，需要可复用的工程约束。
如果把它放进实际使用场景，openwork 的价值主要来自提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性。当前 Star 约 21,452，说明它已经具备一定社区关注度，但商业用户更需要继续验证三件事：是否能嵌入现有业务流程，是否能由团队基于 TypeScript 技术栈持续维护，以及是否能形成稳定交付而不是一次性 Demo。
从商业化和私有化角度看，它更像知识资产而非软件系统，价值在于能否转化为团队开发规范、评审清单或定制化 Agent 工作流。无需复杂部署，但需要根据团队技术栈、代码规范和安全要求改写后才能稳定使用。当前最需要警惕的是：风险在于规则泛化过度，直接复制可能不适合本地项目；需要结合真实仓库测试迭代。因此建议先用一个小范围真实任务做部署测试，再决定它适合作为内部工具、客户方案组件，还是仅作为趋势观察样本。
scenarios: 团队 AI 编码规范
analysis.interpretation: openwork 的评估重点是产品形态、工程成熟度和场景适配，而不是 README 文案本身。对付费信息服务用户来说，它的价值在于帮助快速判断是否值得投入一次部署验证、是否有二次开发空间、是否能成为降本增效工具或商业服务组件。
analysis.installRequirements: 通常需要 TypeScript 相关运行环境，具体版本以官方 README 为准。
analysis.deployment: 无需复杂部署，但需要根据团队技术栈、代码规范和安全要求改写后才能稳定使用。暂未识别出明确 Docker Compose 部署路径，私有化部署成本需要进一步评估。
analysis.commercialValue: 它更像知识资产而非软件系统，价值在于能否转化为团队开发规范、评审清单或定制化 Agent 工作流；由于关注度较高，适合作为竞品研究、工具选型或方案组件候选。
analysis.efficiencyValue: 如果项目与现有工作流匹配，效率价值主要体现在提升 Claude Code 或同类编码 Agent 的执行稳定性，并减少从零选型和重复开发的时间。
analysis.learningValue: 适合学习以 TypeScript 为主的技术栈下同类项目的产品组织、工程结构、README 表达和社区反馈。
analysis.reuseValue: 具备二次开发可能，但需要结合许可证、代码结构、依赖复杂度、接口稳定性和维护节奏判断。
analysis.chinaNotes: 国内使用时要重点检查 GitHub、镜像源、模型服务、第三方 API 和 Docker 镜像访问稳定性。
analysis.risk: 风险在于规则泛化过度，直接复制可能不适合本地项目；需要结合真实仓库测试迭代。
